dedupe_keys.name: data source for probabilistic power flow

description: Data Source for Probabilistic Power Flow is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yan Yang. We have generated 100000 samples. The former samples are used as training data, the middle samples are used as validation data, and the last samples are used as test data. Due to the data privacy, we have not uploaded the data source of practical 661-bus utility system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 617849222 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
